title: NHANES 2017-2018 source map for eGDR, hyperuricemia and gout

formal_study.title: Association between higher estimated glucose disposal rate and reduced prevalence of hyperuricemia and gout
formal_study.design: Secondary cross-sectional analysis of six NHANES cycles, 2007-2018; prevalent outcomes, not incidence or treatment response.

scope: A source-linked core-variable lookup for one survey cycle inside the study's 2007-2018 period. Use it to find files and definitions before planning a new analysis. It is not an analysis-ready dataset or a reproduction of the pooled study.

variables.study_use: Join the selected same-cycle component files by respondent identifier; no row-order join.
variables.source_locator: SEQN; component analytic notes in GHB_J/BIOPRO_J also identify SEQN

variables.study_use: Article sec8 waist circumference maps to the measured waist field.
Use glycohemoglobin percent, matching the coefficient's input unit; not an unconverted mmol/mol value.
Source sec8 includes self-reported physician diagnosis. This is one component, not the entire hypertension definition.
variables.decision_to_document: Refused/unknown must not be silently recoded to No.

variables.units_or_codes: 1 Yes;2 No;7 Refused;9 Don't know; . may reflect questionnaire routing
variables.study_use: Maps current antihypertensive use. BPQ040A asks whether ever told to take medicine and is not equivalent to currently taking it.
variables.decision_to_document: Exact paper handling of routing and partially missing hypertension inputs is not supplied in inspected main Methods.

variables.units_or_codes: mmHg; . missing; recorded diastolic0 is possible
variables.study_use: Article sec8 uses average BP expressed as >=140/90mmHg. CDC describes3 consecutive readings with an optional4th attempt.
variables.decision_to_document: Paper does not specify which readings enter its average, zero/missing handling, minimum valid readings or detailed systolic/diastolic logical operation. Do not choose these silently.

variables.study_use: Article sec9 HUA criterion is strictly >7.0mg/dL in males or >6.0mg/dL in females. LBDSUASI is a different SI-unit field; CDC conversion factor is59.48.
variables.decision_to_document: Sex/urate missing values cannot be classified as non-HUA. This map does not automatically harmonize this cycle with earlier lab instruments.

variables.units_or_codes: 1 Yes; 2 No; 7 Refused; 9 Do not know; . Missing
variables.study_use: Use the reported prior professional diagnosis of gout; only 2 is a negative response. Refused, unknown and missing are not No.

variables.source_locator: RIDAGEYR in DEMO_J/official2017-2018 demographic variable index

variables.study_use: Use the recorded male/female categories for the study's sex-specific urate cutoffs.
variables.source_locator: DEMO_J, RIAGENDR variable definition and code/value table

variables.units_or_codes: 1 Pregnant by test or self-report; 2 Not pregnant at exam; 3 Cannot ascertain; . Missing. Released for females aged 20-44.
variables.study_use: Article sec7 excludes pregnant participants. CDC's public release scope is not a complete pregnancy flag for every female participant.
variables.source_locator: DEMO_J, RIDEXPRG definition, target population and code/value table
variables.decision_to_document: Restricted release and out-of-scope missingness require an explicit exclusion rule. Missing is not by itself a positive pregnancy test or proof of nonpregnancy; the original implementation is not specified.

variables.units_or_codes: Full-sample 2-year MEC exam weight; 0 indicates not MEC examined
variables.study_use: CDC BPX_J says exam weights for BP analysis; BPQ_J says exam weights when merged with MEC data. This is the relevant documented core-map weight, not proof of the paper's exact choice.
variables.source_locator: WTMEC2YR; BPX_J Analytic Notes; BPQ_J Analytic Notes
variables.decision_to_document: Paper sec11 names sampling weights without exact variable/pooled construction. WTINT2YR is interview weight. No six-cycle division or pooled design is prescribed here.

variables.study_use: Keep the complex survey design identifiers with the merged core records. GHB_J/BIOPRO_J specifically call for them.
variables.source_locator: DEMO_J definitions; GHB_J/BIOPRO_J Demographic and Other Related Variables
variables.decision_to_document: No variance estimation or subpopulation analysis has been executed.

definitions.readiness: Urate units/thresholds and RIAGENDR codebook categories verified. Keep missing urate or recorded category separate from non-HUA.

definitions.readiness: Codebook definition/response mapping verified; this is not an imported XPT dataset.

reproduction_decisions: Hypertension includes physician diagnosis, current medication and measured blood pressure. The article does not specify the exact repeated-BP averaging, systolic/diastolic implementation or partially missing-input rules.

The article names sampling weights and survey-design variables without its exact weight variable or pooled construction. CDC identifies WTMEC2YR as the two-year MEC exam weight; this does not certify the original pooled analysis.

BIOPRO_J documents laboratory/instrument changes and bridging guidance for combinations with earlier cycles. This single-cycle map applies no bridging transformation and does not certify the paper's harmonization.
Full model covariates, supplemental definitions, imputation and sensitivity analyses are outside this core map.

readiness.basis: Published study plus official CDC component codebooks; demographic response tables additionally checked directly.
readiness.variable_names: Codebook spellings. Confirm column names and storage types after importing actual XPT files.
readiness.survey_records: Dictionary-level mapping; no analysis-ready participant dataset or fitted results included.
